text:
alex_support: escalation -> SilverCrest (tenant: silver-crest) onboarding blocked. Bulk embeddings 403 + SSO stalled at ACS. Customer asks for go/no-go for GA in 36h. Ticket#80722. Need CS takeover and short comms plan. :rotating_light:
ticketbot: Ticket #80722 created by alex_support. Severity: high. Linked case: 5590.
alex_support: repro: POST /v1/embeddings returns {"error":403,"reason":"quota_enforced"}. last_success: 1755010000. debug token tx_SC99 attached to ticket.
mira_cs: on it. Quick Qs: was there a bulk historical import or delta job? Any large batch at last_success time?
alex_support: they kicked off a bulk ingest (~12k vectors) at 1755009965. Logs show a routing decision that returned quota responses for the tenant for ~60s.
dan_ops: I see a routing flag rollout during that window (1755009950-1755010020) that accidentally routed some tenants into the shared quota pool. Likely a release gating misconfig. I can enable a tenant-level fallback: route to m-lite + enable prefix caching to avoid re-upload. CLI to apply: 
```
redwood-cli tenant update silver-crest --route=m-lite --prefix-cache=on
```
Will hold until CS sends ack to customer.
mira_cs: drafting customer ack: "Thanks SilverCrest  we're investigating and have scheduled a 30min enablement at 17:30 PST. As a temporary measure we'll enable a fallback route so you can continue ingest without a full re-upload; ETA to resume ingest ~90m. We'll follow with an RCA and permanent fix plan." Approve?
alex_support: customer confirmed 17:30 PST. Send ack.
mira_cs: sending ack now and scheduling invite. I'll own the enablement. Jamal from renewals? (cc rachel_renewals)
rachel_renewals: on watch. Renewal risk if unresolved: high -> medium if fallback succeeds. I'll prepare outreach messaging if regression.
dan_ops: applying fallback after ack.
deploy_bot: rolling patch r-20241107-2 to routing flags; watchers notified.
dan_ops: applied fallback at 1755010185. Observing ingest rate climb; 403s dropping.
ticketbot: Ticket #80722 updated: fallback enabled by dan_ops at 1755010185.
dan_ops: metrics: ingestion ramp 0 -> 150 req/min; 403s reduced to <1% since 1755010190. :rocket:
mira_cs: great. Enablement is 17:30 PST — I'll walk through SSO state, confirm no further bulk-job failures, and capture notes. Owners & short plan: 
- Acknowledge & invite: mira_cs (now)
- Triage logs & debug: alex_support + dan_ops (now)
- Apply fallback & monitor: dan_ops (complete)
- Enablement call + customer enable: mira_cs host 17:30 PST
- Renewal sync & follow-up: rachel_renewals (post-call)
Estimated unblock if fallback holds: ~60-120 minutes. Renewal risk: medium until stable 48h.
alex_support: attaching SAML trace + debug logs to the ticket, link to support thread.
mira_cs: post-call notes will include timeline, mitigation steps, and recommended permanent fixes (config guardrail + release checklist). I'll also add a short playbook entry for routing-flag rollbacks.
rachel_renewals: flagged on my side. If we see any regression within 48h escalate to AMs and schedule a proactive check-in.
mira_cs: closing loop for now. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
